title: Robur the Conqueror
creator: Jules Verne
invention: The Albatross, a flying machine lifted by rotors
summary: Robur the Conqueror (French: Robur-le-Conquérant) is a science fiction novel by Jules Verne, published in 1886.

tech.name: VS-300 helicopter
tech.description: The first practical single-rotor helicopter. Sikorsky is said to have cited Robur the Conqueror as his inspiration.

references.title: Smithsonian: Ten Inventions Inspired by Science Fiction, p. 2
